Enabled.Name: Show Flight Deck
Enabled.Hint: Dock the cockpit HUD for your mech. This setting is yours alone; other players choose for themselves. Alt+C also turns it on and collapses it.

DockSide.Name: Dock side
DockSide.Hint: Left sits beside the scene controls. Right sits beside the chat notifications.

Theme.Name: Cockpit theme
Theme.Hint: Match your frame's manufacturer, or pick one. Manufacturers without a theme yet use GMS.

Opacity.Name: Panel opacity
Opacity.Hint: How solid the panel looks while the mouse is elsewhere. It becomes fully solid on hover.

HideTah.Name: Hide Token Action HUD while open
HideTah.Hint: Token Action HUD's bar sits behind the docked panel and shows through it. While the panel is open on your mech, the bar is hidden; collapse or hide the panel to bring it back. Token Action HUD's own settings aren't touched.

ReduceMotion.Name: Reduce motion
ReduceMotion.Hint: Stops flashing, shaking and scanline effects. Auto follows your operating system setting.

Boot.Name: Cold boot sequence
Boot.Hint: A quick, skippable boot sequence (about three seconds) whenever the panel opens or expands, when combat starts, and after a Shut Down ends.

Audio.Name: Cockpit audio
Audio.Hint: Short synthesized cues for Danger Zone, stress and structure hits, Lock On, Exposed and meltdowns. Only you hear them, through Foundry's Interface volume.

Volume.Name: Cockpit audio volume
Volume.Hint: Scales the cues on top of Foundry's Interface volume slider.

DangerHum.Name: Danger Zone afterglow
DangerHum.Hint: After the spool-up, a low reactor hum that fades away over about twelve seconds.

Offer.Name: Offer Flight Deck to players
Offer.Hint: Ask each player once, when they first log in with a mech, whether they want the panel. They can change it any time.

Scale.Name: Panel size
Scale.Hint: Scales the whole panel evenly. You can also drag the grip in its bottom corner (double-click it to reset).

PlayerLockOn.Name: Players can Lock On tokens they do not own
PlayerLockOn.Hint: Lock On is the one condition players put on enemies. With this on, the active GM applies a player's Lock On to the token they target. All other conditions only ever apply to tokens the player owns.

TokenFx.Name: Condition effects on tokens
TokenFx.Hint: Show Flight Deck's condition visuals on tokens (Lock On reticle, Slowed web, Immobile chains, Stunned sparks, Prone tip-over and more). Drawn on your screen only, so this is your choice alone.

TokenFxOpacity.Name: Condition effect strength
TokenFxOpacity.Hint: How strongly Flight Deck's token overlays show.

ArtFx.Name: Condition effects on token art (Token Magic FX)
ArtFx.Hint: Exposed burns red-hot, Shredded trails white smoke, Jammed and Impaired crackle with electricity. These filters are saved on the token, so everyone sees them; the GM's client applies them. Turning this off removes them.

JammedSource.Name: Jammed effect
JammedSource.Hint: Flight Deck's Jammed crawls with bright electricity and keeps the token art visible. Lancer QoL's version tints the token near-black blue. With Flight Deck chosen, Flight Deck removes QoL's Jammed filter where both would stack.

SpendActions.Name: HUD menus spend actions
SpendActions.Hint: When an action from a HUD menu goes through (an attack that isn't cancelled, a card that posts), mark its slot spent on the mech's action tracker. LANCER resets the tracker at the start of each turn.

NpcDeck.Name: NPC Deck (GM)
NpcDeck.Hint: A board of every NPC in the fight, for GMs: health, heat, conditions, activations, who's targeting each, and their features one click away. Alt+N collapses it.

NpcDeckSide.Name: NPC Deck side
NpcDeckSide.Hint: Which side of the screen the NPC Deck docks on.

NpcDeckScale.Name: NPC Deck size
NpcDeckScale.Hint: Scale the whole NPC Deck. You can also drag its corner grip.

AutoDamage.Name: Roll damage after a hit
AutoDamage.Hint: When an attack you make hits or crits at least one target, LANCER's damage roll opens by itself, as if you'd pressed ROLL DAMAGE on the attack card. Works for attacks from anywhere: the HUD, the sheet, macros. The button stays on the card for re-rolls.

Toggle.Name: Toggle Flight Deck
Toggle.Hint: Turns the panel on if it is off; otherwise collapses or expands it.

Menu.Hint: Open or close this Flight Deck HUD menu.

NpcDeck.Name: NPC Deck
NpcDeck.Hint: GM: show the NPC Deck, then collapse or expand it.

Offer.Title: Flight Deck
Offer.Body: Flight Deck is a cockpit HUD for your mech: heat and Danger Zone, your next Overcharge cost, structure and stress odds, and warning lights, with short optional sound cues. Turn it on? You can change this any time in Configure Settings, or with Alt+C.

Header.StandbyHint: Select your mech's token, or set your character in Player Configuration.
Header.Hide: Hide Flight Deck (bring it back from Token Controls or Alt+C)
Header.Hidden: Flight Deck hidden. Bring it back with the gauge button in Token Controls, or Alt+C.

Integrity.Title: Integrity
Integrity.NextHitLethal: Next structure loss destroys the mech
Integrity.NextOverheatLethal: Next stress loss destroys the mech
Integrity.LethalTipStructure: One structure left: the next structure damage destroys the mech, no roll.
Integrity.LethalTipStress: One stress left: the next stress damage ends the mech, no roll.
Integrity.AltRulesTip: LANCER Alternative Structure is active: these odds use its tables. No single roll destroys the mech; a failed check decides.

exposed.Name: Exposed
exposed.Text: Kinetic, explosive and energy damage it takes is doubled, before any reductions.
exposed.Ends: Clears when the mech Stabilizes, or shuts down.

shredded.Name: Shredded
shredded.Text: It gets no benefit from Armor or Resistance.
shredded.Ends: Usually until the end of its next turn; the effect that caused it says.

stunned.Name: Stunned
stunned.Text: It can't move, Overcharge or take any actions, free actions and reactions included. Its Evasion is capped at 5 and it automatically fails HULL and AGILITY checks and saves. The pilot can still mount, dismount or eject.
stunned.Ends: Usually until the end of its next turn.

meltdown.Name: Reactor meltdown
meltdown.Text: The reactor is going critical. When the countdown runs out, the mech is destroyed in a reactor explosion that also hits everything nearby. Time to eject or get clear.
meltdown.Alt: Alternative Structure: Stabilizing, or passing an ENGINEERING check as a quick action, ends the countdown.

lockon.Name: Lock On
lockon.Text: Hostiles can consume Lock On for +1 Accuracy on their next attack against it. Some talents and systems need a Locked On target.

jammed.Name: Jammed
jammed.Text: No comms, no reactions, and no tech actions, taken or benefited from. Its only attacks are Improvised Attacks, Grapple and Ram.
jammed.Ends: Usually until the end of its next turn.

impaired.Name: Impaired
impaired.Text: +1 Difficulty on all attacks, saves and checks.
impaired.Ends: Usually until the end of its next turn.

dangerzone.Name: Danger Zone
dangerzone.Text: Heat is at half the Heat Cap or more. It isn't a penalty in itself, but some weapons, systems and talents switch on or get stronger in the Danger Zone, and the next overheat is closer.
dangerzone.Ends: Ends when heat drops below half the cap.

slowed.Name: Slowed
slowed.Text: Its only movement is its standard move on its own turn: no Boost, and no special moves from talents, systems or weapons.
slowed.Ends: Usually until the end of its next turn.

immobilized.Name: Immobilized
immobilized.Text: It can't move of its own accord at all, though it can still be pushed, pulled or knocked back.
immobilized.Ends: Usually until the end of its next turn.

engaged.Name: Engaged
engaged.Text: It's adjacent to a hostile character, and both are Engaged. Ranged attacks it makes take +1 Difficulty, and if it becomes Engaged mid-move by something its size or bigger, it stops and loses the rest of the move.
engaged.Ends: Ends when it's no longer adjacent to a hostile.

prone.Name: Prone
prone.Text: Attacks against it gain +1 Accuracy. It's Slowed and moves as if through difficult terrain.
prone.Ends: Standing up takes its standard move (not while Immobilized) and doesn't count as movement.

burn.Name: Burn
burn.Text: Burn deals its damage (ignoring Armor) when it lands and adds to this counter. At the end of each turn it rolls ENGINEERING: a success clears all Burn, a failure deals damage equal to the counter again.

overshield.Name: Overshield
overshield.Text: Temporary hit points that soak damage before HP. Overshield doesn't stack: only the highest value counts.

hidden.Name: Hidden
hidden.Text: Hostiles can't target it with attacks or actions, it doesn't cause engagement, and enemies only know roughly where it is. Attacking, forcing a save, taking a reaction, Boosting or losing cover ends Hidden; a Search can find it.

invisible.Name: Invisible
invisible.Text: Every attack against it, area effects included, has a flat 50% chance to miss before anything is rolled. It can Hide even without cover.

shutdown.Name: Shut Down
shutdown.Text: The reactor is offline. Heat and Exposed are cleared, cascading NHPs are stabilised, and statuses from tech actions (such as Lock On) end. It's immune to all tech actions and attacks, even friendly ones, and Stunned until it boots up.
shutdown.Ends: Boot Up (a full action) brings it back online.

Action.Title: Actions
Action.HintToggle: Click: open menu · Right-click: mark spent / available
Action.HintReaction: Click: open menu · Right-click: mark the reaction spent / available · Shift+right-click: the protocol

Error.NotOwner: Flight Deck: you don't own this mech.
Error.NoFrame: Flight Deck: this mech has no frame installed.
Error.Overcharge: Flight Deck: the Overcharge flow failed. See the console (F12).
Error.Stabilize: Flight Deck: the Stabilize flow failed. See the console (F12).
Error.Core: Flight Deck: the Core Power flow failed. See the console (F12).
Error.Action: Flight Deck: that action failed. See the console (F12).

Move.Hint: Drag to move. Drop at a screen edge to dock.

Resize.Label: Panel size
Resize.Hint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset · arrow keys adjust

Edit.Hint: Type a value, or +n / -n to adjust. Enter applies, Esc cancels.
Edit.Invalid: Flight Deck: enter a number, or +n / -n.

Apply.NoSelection: Select your token to apply conditions.
Apply.HintHidden: {target}: click toggles Hidden · right-click toggles Invisible
Apply.HintMeltdown: {target}: click starts or clears a meltdown countdown · right-click ticks it down
Apply.Failed: Flight Deck: could not apply to {name} ({reason}).
Apply.NotAllowed: the GM has turned off Lock On for tokens you do not own
Apply.NoGM: no GM is connected to apply it
Apply.NoTarget: Target a token (T) to Lock On.
Apply.NotOwned: you can only apply this condition to tokens you own
Apply.ConditionsHint: Conditions apply to your selected token(s), or to the mech on this panel when nothing is selected.
Apply.LockOnHint: Lock On applies to your target(s) (press T over a token), or to your selection when nothing is targeted.
Apply.DangerZoneQol: Follows heat: Lancer QoL sets and clears Danger Zone automatically.

Meltdown.Title: Reactor meltdown
Meltdown.Body: Start a countdown on the selected mech. The panel shows it as T-n; right-click the tile to tick it down at the end of each turn.

Check.SentToPlayer: Flight Deck: the {kind} check prompt went to {players}, who owns {name}.
Check.AutomationOff: Flight Deck: LANCER's structure automation is off, so no {kind} check was started.

Hull.Name: Hull
Hull.Use: Toughness and brute force: resisting being knocked down or shoved, lifting and smashing.

Agility.Name: Agility
Agility.Use: Speed and evasion: dodging blasts and hazards, slipping out of grabs.

Systems.Name: Systems
Systems.Use: Electronics and sensors: shrugging off jamming, hacking and other electronic effects.

Engineering.Name: Engineering
Engineering.Use: Reactor and power: handling heat and keeping the reactor stable.

Systems.Title: Systems available
Systems.ButtonHint: Your mech's systems: hover for the rules, click to post to chat
Systems.ClickHint: Click to post its full text to chat

Spent.quick: No quick actions left this turn.
Spent.full: No full action left this turn.
Spent.invade: No quick action left for an invade.

Hint.systemUse: Click: use it (LANCER spends a use and applies its heat)
Hint.deploy: Click: deploy it beside your mech
Hint.recall: Click: recall it from the field
Hint.redeploy: Click: redeploy it, then drag it to its new space

Hud.ResetMoveHint: Set remaining movement back to your Speed.

WeaponNote.skirmish: One weapon (not Superheavy), then a free Auxiliary on the same mount.
WeaponNote.barrage: Two weapons, or one Superheavy, then a free Auxiliary on each mount fired.
WeaponNote.overwatch: Skirmish a hostile as it starts moving in your Threat.

Footer.actions: Hover: detail · Click: execute · Esc: close
Footer.systems: Hover: rules · Click: post full text to chat

Hud.MoveModeText: Sets how your token's next move is measured and drawn on the ruler.

MoveModes.teleport: For abilities that teleport you: the move isn't blocked by anything in between.
MoveModes.blink: For movement that teleports you: the move isn't blocked by anything in between.

Hud.UsedRound: Already used this round. Each reaction can be taken once per round.
Hud.OneTarget: This targets one character: target just one token.
Hud.AuxNote: Free attack with an Auxiliary weapon on a mount you fired. No bonus damage.
Hud.AuxDoneTip: End this weapon action without an Auxiliary follow-up.

WeaponBlockedTip.fired: That weapon has already fired in this action.
WeaponBlockedTip.superheavyBarrage: Superheavy weapons can only be fired as part of a Barrage.
WeaponBlockedTip.superheavyWhole: A Superheavy weapon takes the whole Barrage: fire it as the first attack.
WeaponBlockedTip.notAux: Only an Auxiliary weapon can make the follow-up attack.
WeaponBlockedTip.otherMount: The follow-up must come from a mount that fired.
WeaponBlockedTip.auxUsed: That mount has already made its follow-up attack.
WeaponBlockedTip.notReady: That weapon can't fire right now: it's destroyed, unloaded or out of uses.

skirmish.Name: Skirmish
skirmish.Text: Attack with one weapon. If it isn't Superheavy, you may also fire one Auxiliary weapon on the same mount, at the same or a different target, without bonus damage.

boost.Name: Boost
boost.Text: Move up to your Speed again. It's extra movement on top of your standard move, and anything that triggers on a Boost triggers.

grapple.Name: Grapple
grapple.Text: Make a melee attack against an adjacent character. On a hit you're grappling: you're both Engaged, neither of you can Boost or take reactions, and the larger side drags the smaller when it moves. Either side breaks free with a contested Hull check.

ram.Name: Ram
ram.Text: Make a melee attack against an adjacent character your Size or smaller. On a hit, knock them Prone and push them 1 space directly away from you.

hide.Name: Hide
hide.Text: If no hostile has line of sight to you, or you're in cover from all of them, you become Hidden. It ends when you attack, lose that cover, or someone finds you with Search.

search.Name: Search
search.Text: Look for Hidden characters within your Sensors: make a contested Systems check against their Agility. Win, and they're revealed.

prepare.Name: Prepare
prepare.Text: Pick another quick action and a trigger. Until the start of your next turn, when the trigger happens you may take that action as a reaction.

eject.Name: Eject
eject.Text: Your pilot bails out, flying up to 6 spaces in a direction of your choice. The empty mech is left Impaired.

shutdown.Name: Shut Down
shutdown.Text: Power down. All heat and Exposed clear, and a cascading NHP is brought back under control. Until you Boot Up, the mech is Stunned but immune to tech actions and attacks.

selfdestruct.Name: Self-Destruct
selfdestruct.Text: Overload the reactor. At the end of your next turn, or the turn after (your choice), the mech is destroyed in a reactor meltdown that blasts everything nearby. Get out first.

bolster.Name: Bolster
bolster.Text: Choose a character within Sensors. Their next skill check or save gets +2 Accuracy. A character benefits from only one Bolster at a time.

lockon.Name: Lock On
lockon.Text: Choose a character within Sensors and line of sight: they gain Lock On. The next attacker can clear it for +1 Accuracy, and some weapons and systems use it for more.

scan.Name: Scan
scan.Text: Choose a character or object within Sensors and line of sight and learn something hidden about it: its stats, a weapon, a system, or its current state.

invade.Name: Invade
invade.Text: Make a tech attack against a character within Sensors and line of sight. On a hit, they take 2 heat and suffer an invade option: Fragment Signal, or one from your systems.

barrage.Name: Barrage
barrage.Text: Attack with two weapons, or with one Superheavy weapon.

improvised.Name: Improvised Attack
improvised.Text: Make a melee attack with whatever's at hand: a fist, a girder, a car. On a hit it deals 1d6 kinetic damage.

stabilize.Name: Stabilize
stabilize.Text: Either cool down (clear all heat and Exposed) or spend 1 Repair to restore all HP. Then reload your Loading weapons, clear Burn, or clear a condition on you or an adjacent ally. The system walks you through it.

disengage.Name: Disengage
disengage.Text: Until the end of your turn, you ignore engagement and your movement doesn't provoke reactions.

bootup.Name: Boot Up
bootup.Text: Bring your Shut Down mech back online.

mount.Name: Mount / Dismount
mount.Text: Climb into an adjacent mech's cockpit, or climb out of yours into an adjacent space.

jockey.Name: Jockey
jockey.Text: On foot only: climb onto an adjacent mech and make a contested Hull check. Win, and you hang on, choosing each turn to distract it, shred its systems or damage it, until you're thrown off.

fulltech.Name: Full Tech
fulltech.Text: Take two quick tech actions (the same one twice is fine), or one full tech action from your systems.

brace.Name: Brace
brace.Text: Once per round, when you're hit and damage has been rolled: you're Resistant to all damage, heat and burn from that attack, and other attacks against you take +1 Difficulty until the end of your next turn. On that turn you can take only one quick action and no reactions.

overwatch.Name: Overwatch
overwatch.Text: Once per round, when a hostile starts any movement inside one of your weapons' Threat: Skirmish them with that weapon before they move.

fragment.Name: Fragment Signal
fragment.Text: The basic invade option. On a hit, the target becomes Impaired and Slowed until the end of their next turn.

overcharge.Name: Overcharge
overcharge.Text: Free action, once per turn: take one extra quick action, then take heat from your Overcharge track.
